title: An attractive analytic solution of the Maxwell's equation
summary: In this paper, we aim to develop a closed-form solution of the standard Maxwell's equations that describe the propagation of electromagnetic waves in an isotropic homogeneous medium such as a vacuum. The proposed solution has a simple analytic structure that explains how initial conditions characterize the underlying electromagnetic wave. As such, it can be used as a tool to generate suitable electromagnetic waves in practice.
